note: Machine-readable companion to coordination/pillars/space.md. UNKNOWN is intentional unless candidate-specific evidence supports PASS or FAIL.

geometry.note: Explicit candidate metric/geometry with parameters and provenance is still required.

eom.note: Candidate-specific equations of motion plus reproducible evaluation are required.

residual.note: Numerical or symbolic residual report with tolerance is required.

nec.note: Observer-robust all-frame certificate for the candidate is required.

energy.note: Candidate stress-energy / integrated energy with units, domain and provenance is required.

curvature_tidal.note: Curvature invariants and tidal bounds over the relevant domain are required.

horizon.note: Horizon or trapped-surface analysis for candidate and target velocity is required.

causality.note: Global/local causal-structure and chronology checks are required.

stability.note: Candidate-specific linear/nonlinear stability result is required.

eft.note: Cutoff/derivative-expansion analysis within the controlled regime is required.
